name: requirement
example: Please list every requirement in the PRD before the design review.
exampleTrans: 设计评审前请在 PRD 中列出每一条需求。

name: roadmap
example: We updated the roadmap after the quarterly planning meeting.
exampleTrans: 季度规划会后我们更新了产品路线图。

name: stakeholder
example: We need sign-off from every key stakeholder before launch.
exampleTrans: 上线前我们需要每位关键干系人的签字确认。

name: scope
example: Let's keep the scope small so we can ship this sprint.
exampleTrans: 我们把范围控制小一点，这样本迭代就能发布。

name: priority
example: Payment bugs are our top priority for this release.
exampleTrans: 支付相关的缺陷是本次发版的最高优先级。

name: prioritize
example: We prioritize features by user impact and engineering effort.
exampleTrans: 我们根据用户影响和研发工作量给功能排优先级。

name: backlog
example: I moved the export feature back into the backlog.
exampleTrans: 我把导出功能挪回了需求池。

name: PRD
example: The PRD explains the problem, goals and success metrics.
exampleTrans: 这份 PRD 说明了问题、目标和成功指标。

name: user story
example: Each user story should describe who, what and why.
exampleTrans: 每个用户故事都应该说明是谁、做什么以及为什么。

name: acceptance criteria
example: QA will test against the acceptance criteria in the ticket.
exampleTrans: 测试会按照工单里的验收标准进行验证。

name: use case
example: The main use case is managers approving expenses on mobile.
exampleTrans: 主要使用场景是经理在手机上审批报销。

name: specification
example: The API specification must be finalized before the frontend starts.
exampleTrans: 前端开工前必须定稿接口规格说明。

name: MVP
example: Our MVP only supports email login and basic search.
exampleTrans: 我们的最小可行产品只支持邮箱登录和基础搜索。

name: milestone
example: Finishing the beta is the next major milestone.
exampleTrans: 完成公测版本是下一个重要里程碑。

name: trade-off
example: Shipping faster is a trade-off against test coverage.
exampleTrans: 更快发布是以测试覆盖率为代价的取舍。

name: launch
example: We plan to launch the new onboarding flow in March.
exampleTrans: 我们计划在三月上线新的新手引导流程。

name: release
example: The release notes summarize every user-facing change in this version.
exampleTrans: 发版说明总结了所有面向用户的改动。

name: KPI
example: Daily active users is the main KPI for this team.
exampleTrans: 日活跃用户是这个团队的核心绩效指标。

name: OKR
example: Our OKR this quarter is to double weekly retention.
exampleTrans: 我们本季度的 OKR 是把周留存翻倍。

name: metric
example: Which metric will tell us whether the feature succeeded?
exampleTrans: 哪个指标能告诉我们这个功能是否成功？

name: north star metric
example: Our north star metric is the number of weekly bookings.
exampleTrans: 我们的北极星指标是每周预订量。

name: churn
example: Churn increased after we raised the subscription price.
exampleTrans: 我们提高订阅价格后流失率上升了。

name: retention
example: Day seven retention improved by four percent after the redesign.
exampleTrans: 改版后七日留存提升了四个百分点。

name: conversion
example: The new pricing page lifted conversion from trial to paid.
exampleTrans: 新的定价页提升了试用转付费的转化。

name: conversion rate
example: Our checkout conversion rate dropped after the last release.
exampleTrans: 上次发版后我们的结账转化率下降了。

name: funnel
example: Most users leave the funnel at the payment step.
exampleTrans: 大多数用户在支付这一步离开了漏斗。

name: engagement
example: Push notifications boosted engagement but also raised uninstalls.
exampleTrans: 推送通知提升了活跃度，但也增加了卸载量。

name: cohort
example: The January cohort retained better than the February cohort.
exampleTrans: 一月同期群的留存好于二月同期群。

name: DAU
example: DAU dipped during the holiday but recovered within a week.
exampleTrans: 假期期间日活下滑，但一周内就恢复了。

name: MAU
example: We report MAU to the board every quarter.
exampleTrans: 我们每季度向董事会汇报月活跃用户数。

name: A-B test
example: We ran an A-B test on two versions of the signup button.
exampleTrans: 我们对两个版本的注册按钮做了 A/B 测试。

name: experiment
example: The experiment needs two weeks to reach statistical significance.
exampleTrans: 这个实验需要两周才能达到统计显著。

name: hypothesis
example: Our hypothesis is that shorter forms will increase signups.
exampleTrans: 我们的假设是更短的表单会提升注册量。

name: validate
example: We need to validate demand before building the full feature.
exampleTrans: 在做完整功能之前我们需要先验证需求。

name: alignment
example: This meeting is to get alignment on the launch date.
exampleTrans: 这次会议是为了就上线日期达成一致。

name: align
example: Let's align with the design team before we finalize the spec.
exampleTrans: 定稿需求前我们先和设计团队对齐一下。

name: sign-off
example: We still need legal sign-off on the privacy policy changes.
exampleTrans: 隐私政策的修改还需要法务签字确认。

name: go-to-market
example: Marketing is drafting the go-to-market plan for Europe.
exampleTrans: 市场部正在起草欧洲市场的上市计划。

name: product-market fit
example: Strong organic growth suggests we are close to product-market fit.
exampleTrans: 强劲的自然增长表明我们接近产品市场契合了。

name: value proposition
example: Our value proposition is saving finance teams ten hours a week.
exampleTrans: 我们的价值主张是每周为财务团队节省十小时。

name: review
example: Please review the wireframes and leave comments by tomorrow.
exampleTrans: 请在明天前审阅线框图并留下评论。

name: mockup
example: The designer will send the final mockup on Monday.
exampleTrans: 设计师周一会发来最终视觉稿。

name: UX
example: The UX of the filter panel confuses new users.
exampleTrans: 筛选面板的用户体验让新用户感到困惑。

name: effort
example: This change is low effort but high impact.
exampleTrans: 这个改动工作量小但影响大。

name: impact
example: We ranked the ideas by expected impact on revenue.
exampleTrans: 我们按对收入的预期影响给这些想法排序。

name: ROI
example: The ROI of this integration is unclear without customer data.
exampleTrans: 没有客户数据，这个集成的投资回报率不明确。

name: resource
example: We don't have enough resources to build both features this quarter.
exampleTrans: 本季度我们没有足够的人力同时做这两个功能。

name: risk
example: The biggest risk is that the partner API changes before launch.
exampleTrans: 最大的风险是合作方接口在上线前发生变化。

name: rollout
example: The rollout will start with five percent of users.
exampleTrans: 这次上线会先从百分之五的用户开始。

name: roll back
example: We had to roll back the release because of a crash.
exampleTrans: 因为崩溃问题我们不得不回滚这次发版。

name: beta
example: We invited fifty customers to join the private beta.
exampleTrans: 我们邀请了五十位客户参加内测。

name: pilot
example: The pilot with two hospitals went better than expected.
exampleTrans: 与两家医院的试点效果好于预期。

name: deliverable
example: The main deliverable this month is the updated checkout flow.
exampleTrans: 本月的主要交付物是更新后的结账流程。

name: timeline
example: The timeline assumes design is finished by the end of May.
exampleTrans: 这个排期假设设计在五月底前完成。

name: initiative
example: This initiative aims to cut support tickets by half.
exampleTrans: 这项举措旨在把客服工单减少一半。

name: objective
example: The objective of this release is to improve first-time activation.
exampleTrans: 这次发版的目标是提高首次激活率。

name: success metric
example: Every PRD should define at least one success metric.
exampleTrans: 每份 PRD 都应至少定义一个成功指标。

name: baseline
example: We need a baseline before we can measure the improvement.
exampleTrans: 我们需要先有基线，才能衡量改进效果。

name: activation
example: We define activation as creating the first project within a day.
exampleTrans: 我们把激活定义为一天内创建首个项目。

name: acquisition
example: Paid acquisition costs rose sharply in the last quarter.
exampleTrans: 上季度付费获客成本大幅上升。

name: growth
example: The growth team is testing referral rewards this month.
exampleTrans: 增长团队这个月在测试推荐奖励。

name: monetization
example: Our monetization strategy depends on converting free teams to paid plans.
exampleTrans: 我们的变现策略依赖于把免费团队转化为付费套餐。

name: revenue
example: Enterprise deals account for most of our annual revenue.
exampleTrans: 企业客户订单贡献了我们大部分年收入。

name: pricing
example: We are revisiting pricing for the small team plan.
exampleTrans: 我们正在重新考虑小团队套餐的定价。

name: subscription
example: Most users cancel their subscription in the second month.
exampleTrans: 大多数用户在第二个月取消订阅。

name: LTV
trans: n. 用户生命周期价值
example: Annual plans have a much higher LTV than monthly plans.
exampleTrans: 年付套餐的用户生命周期价值远高于月付套餐。

name: CAC
example: Our CAC doubled after we expanded into new channels.
exampleTrans: 拓展新渠道后我们的获客成本翻了一倍。

name: ARPU
example: ARPU went up after we introduced the premium tier.
exampleTrans: 推出高级档位后每用户平均收入上升了。

name: competitor
example: Our main competitor just released a similar feature for free.
exampleTrans: 我们的主要竞争对手刚免费发布了类似功能。

name: market research
example: Market research shows strong demand among freelance designers.
exampleTrans: 市场调研显示自由设计师群体需求旺盛。

name: target audience
example: Our target audience is operations teams at mid-sized companies.
exampleTrans: 我们的目标用户群是中型公司的运营团队。

name: segment
example: Enterprise customers are our fastest growing segment this year.
exampleTrans: 企业客户是我们增长最快的细分群体。

name: segmentation
example: Better segmentation helps us send more relevant emails.
exampleTrans: 更好的用户分群帮助我们发送更相关的邮件。

name: insight
example: The key insight is that users want templates, not blank pages.
exampleTrans: 关键洞察是用户想要模板，而不是空白页。

name: user interview
example: I scheduled six user interviews for next week.
exampleTrans: 我为下周安排了六场用户访谈。

name: NPS
example: Our NPS rose to forty after the performance improvements.
exampleTrans: 性能优化后我们的净推荐值升到了四十。

name: customer journey
example: We redesigned the customer journey from trial to renewal.
exampleTrans: 我们重新设计了从试用到续费的客户旅程。

name: jobs-to-be-done
example: Using jobs-to-be-done, we found the core need is splitting a bill quickly with friends.
exampleTrans: 借助待完成任务理论，我们发现核心需求是和朋友快速分账。

name: problem statement
example: Start the PRD with a clear problem statement.
exampleTrans: PRD 要以清晰的问题陈述开头。

name: assumption
example: List every assumption so we can test the risky ones first.
exampleTrans: 把每个假设都列出来，这样我们可以先验证风险高的。

name: out of scope
example: Offline mode is out of scope for the first release.
exampleTrans: 离线模式不在首个版本的范围内。

name: scope creep
example: Adding reports late in the sprint is classic scope creep.
exampleTrans: 在迭代后期加报表需求是典型的范围蔓延。

name: non-functional requirement
example: Page load under two seconds is a non-functional requirement.
exampleTrans: 页面两秒内加载完成是一项非功能性需求。

name: must-have
example: Bulk import is a must-have for enterprise customers.
exampleTrans: 批量导入对企业客户来说是必备功能。

name: nice-to-have
example: Custom themes are a nice-to-have, not a launch requirement.
exampleTrans: 自定义主题是锦上添花的功能，不是上线必需的。

name: MoSCoW
example: We used MoSCoW to sort the requirements with stakeholders.
exampleTrans: 我们与干系人一起用 MoSCoW 方法给需求分类。

name: RICE
trans: n. RICE 优先级评分模型
example: Each idea in the backlog gets a RICE score.
exampleTrans: 需求池里的每个想法都有一个 RICE 评分。

name: quick win
example: Fixing the confusing button label is an easy quick win.
exampleTrans: 修改令人困惑的按钮文案是个容易的速赢项。

name: tech debt
example: We reserve twenty percent of each sprint for tech debt.
exampleTrans: 每个迭代我们预留百分之二十用于偿还技术债。

name: epic
example: The checkout redesign epic contains twelve user stories.
exampleTrans: 结账改版这个史诗包含十二个用户故事。

name: story point
example: The team estimated this story at five story points.
exampleTrans: 团队把这个故事估为五个故事点。

name: standup
example: Raise blockers in the daily standup, not at the end of the sprint.
exampleTrans: 在每日站会上提出阻塞问题，而不是到迭代末尾。

name: grooming
example: Backlog grooming happens every Wednesday with the tech lead.
exampleTrans: 每周三我们和技术负责人一起梳理需求池。

name: refinement
example: We clarified the edge cases during the refinement session.
exampleTrans: 我们在需求细化会上澄清了边界情况。

name: kickoff
example: The project kickoff is on Monday with design and engineering.
exampleTrans: 项目启动会定在周一，设计和研发都会参加。

name: cross-functional
example: We built a cross-functional team with design, data and engineering.
exampleTrans: 我们组建了一个包括设计、数据和研发的跨职能团队。

name: owner
example: Who is the owner of the notification settings page?
exampleTrans: 通知设置页的负责人是谁？

name: accountable
example: The PM is accountable for the success of the launch.
exampleTrans: 产品经理对这次上线的成败负责。

name: takeaway
example: The main takeaway is that users don't trust automatic categories.
exampleTrans: 主要结论是用户不信任自动分类。

name: recap
example: I'll send a quick recap of the decisions after the call.
exampleTrans: 会后我会发一份决策要点的简要总结。

name: deprioritize
example: We deprioritized the export feature to focus on reliability.
exampleTrans: 我们降低了导出功能的优先级，以专注于稳定性。

name: descope
example: We descoped the admin panel to hit the launch date.
exampleTrans: 为了赶上线日期，我们砍掉了管理后台。

name: slip
example: The launch slipped a week because of a security review.
exampleTrans: 由于安全评审，上线推迟了一周。

name: on track
example: The mobile release is on track for the end of the month.
exampleTrans: 移动端版本按计划将在月底发布。

name: at risk
example: The integration milestone is at risk due to vendor delays.
exampleTrans: 由于供应商延期，集成里程碑存在风险。

name: status update
example: I send a weekly status update to all stakeholders.
exampleTrans: 我每周向所有干系人发送进展更新。

name: data-driven
example: We try to make data-driven decisions about the roadmap.
exampleTrans: 我们努力基于数据来做路线图决策。

name: actionable
example: Please turn the research findings into actionable recommendations.
exampleTrans: 请把研究发现转化为可落地的建议。

name: feasibility
example: We did a feasibility study before committing to the roadmap.
exampleTrans: 在承诺列入路线图之前我们做了可行性研究。

name: viable
example: The freemium model is not viable without better conversion.
exampleTrans: 没有更好的转化，免费增值模式行不通。

name: intuitive
example: The new navigation feels much more intuitive to testers.
exampleTrans: 测试用户觉得新导航直观多了。

name: granular
example: Enterprise admins asked for more granular permission settings in the console.
exampleTrans: 企业管理员要求在控制台中提供更细粒度的权限设置。

name: incremental
example: We prefer incremental improvements over one big redesign.
exampleTrans: 相比一次大改版，我们更倾向于渐进式改进。

name: strategic
example: Expanding into Japan is a strategic priority this year.
exampleTrans: 拓展日本市场是今年的战略重点。

name: strategy
example: Our product strategy this year focuses on mid-market customers.
exampleTrans: 我们今年的产品战略聚焦中端市场客户。

name: vision
example: The product vision is to make expense reports disappear.
exampleTrans: 产品愿景是让报销单彻底消失。

name: differentiator
example: Offline support is our key differentiator in this market.
exampleTrans: 离线支持是我们在这个市场的关键差异化优势。

name: differentiate
example: We differentiate through better integrations, not lower prices.
exampleTrans: 我们靠更好的集成形成差异，而非更低价格。

name: positioning
example: The new positioning targets teams that have outgrown simple spreadsheets.
exampleTrans: 新的定位针对已不满足于简单电子表格的团队。

name: TAM
example: The TAM for small business accounting software is huge.
exampleTrans: 小企业会计软件的潜在市场总量非常大。

name: SaaS
example: Most SaaS companies track monthly recurring revenue closely.
exampleTrans: 大多数 SaaS 公司会密切跟踪月度经常性收入。

name: freemium
example: Our freemium plan limits users to three projects.
exampleTrans: 我们的免费增值套餐限制用户最多三个项目。

name: upsell
example: We upsell storage when teams reach their quota.
exampleTrans: 当团队达到配额时我们向其推销更多存储空间。

name: retain
example: Weekly digests help us retain users who rarely log in.
exampleTrans: 每周摘要帮助我们留住很少登录的用户。

name: engage
example: We want to engage dormant users with personalized reminders.
exampleTrans: 我们想用个性化提醒唤醒沉默用户。

name: drop-off
example: There is a big drop-off between signup and email verification.
exampleTrans: 从注册到邮箱验证之间流失很严重。

name: bounce rate
example: The landing page bounce rate is above seventy percent.
exampleTrans: 落地页的跳出率超过百分之七十。

name: click-through rate
example: The new banner doubled the click-through rate on mobile.
exampleTrans: 新横幅让移动端点击率翻了一倍。

name: stickiness
example: The DAU to MAU ratio is our main measure of stickiness.
exampleTrans: 日活与月活之比是我们衡量用户黏性的主要指标。

name: power user
example: Power users asked for keyboard shortcuts in the editor.
exampleTrans: 重度用户要求在编辑器里加入快捷键。

name: early adopter
example: Early adopters gave us honest feedback on the beta.
exampleTrans: 早期使用者对测试版给出了真诚的反馈。

name: lifecycle
example: Different emails go out at each stage of the user lifecycle.
exampleTrans: 在用户生命周期的不同阶段会发送不同的邮件。

name: attribution
example: Marketing attribution is hard when users switch devices.
exampleTrans: 用户切换设备时，营销归因很难做。

name: statistically significant
example: The lift in signups was not statistically significant.
exampleTrans: 注册量的提升在统计上并不显著。

name: sample size
example: We need a larger sample size before drawing conclusions.
exampleTrans: 在得出结论前我们需要更大的样本量。

name: analytics
example: We added analytics events to track each step of checkout.
exampleTrans: 我们添加了埋点事件来追踪结账的每一步。

name: tracking
example: Tracking for the new feature must be ready before launch.
exampleTrans: 新功能的埋点必须在上线前准备好。

name: instrument
example: Please instrument the share button so we can measure usage.
exampleTrans: 请给分享按钮埋点，这样我们能衡量使用情况。

name: trend
example: The trend in weekly signups has been flat since June.
exampleTrans: 自六月以来每周注册量的趋势一直持平。

name: spike
example: We saw a spike in support tickets after the update.
exampleTrans: 更新后客服工单出现了激增。

name: uplift
example: The experiment showed a three percent uplift in conversion.
exampleTrans: 实验显示转化率提升了百分之三。

name: leading indicator
example: Weekly active teams is a leading indicator of renewals.
exampleTrans: 周活跃团队数是续费的先行指标。

name: lagging indicator
example: Revenue is a lagging indicator of product quality.
exampleTrans: 收入是产品质量的滞后指标。

name: guardrail metric
example: Page load time is a guardrail metric for this experiment.
exampleTrans: 页面加载时间是本次实验的护栏指标。

name: brief
example: I wrote a short brief for the design team.
exampleTrans: 我为设计团队写了一份简短的需求简报。

name: one-pager
example: Send me a one-pager explaining the opportunity and the cost.
exampleTrans: 给我发一份一页纸方案，说明机会和成本。

name: proposal
example: The proposal compares three options for the new pricing model.
exampleTrans: 这份提案比较了新定价模式的三种方案。

name: rationale
example: Please add the rationale behind each priority in the doc.
exampleTrans: 请在文档中补充每个优先级背后的理由。

name: discovery
example: We spent two weeks on discovery before writing any code.
exampleTrans: 在写代码之前我们花了两周做产品探索。

name: pivot
example: The startup pivoted from consumers to small businesses.
exampleTrans: 这家初创公司从面向消费者转向了面向小企业。

name: sunset
example: We plan to sunset the old reporting module next year.
exampleTrans: 我们计划明年下线旧的报表模块。

name: integration
example: Enterprise customers keep asking for a calendar integration this quarter.
exampleTrans: 企业客户本季度一直在要求日历集成。

name: platform
example: We are turning the app into a platform for third-party plugins.
exampleTrans: 我们正把应用打造成支持第三方插件的平台。

name: ecosystem
example: A healthy plugin ecosystem keeps customers on our platform.
exampleTrans: 健康的插件生态能把客户留在我们的平台上。

name: compliance
example: GDPR compliance is required before we launch in Europe.
exampleTrans: 在欧洲上线前必须符合 GDPR 合规要求。

name: localization
example: Localization for Japanese and Korean is planned for the summer.
exampleTrans: 日语和韩语的本地化计划在夏季完成。

name: performance
example: Performance on older Android phones is still too slow.
exampleTrans: 在旧款安卓手机上的性能仍然太慢。

name: reliability
example: This quarter we are focusing on reliability, not new features.
exampleTrans: 本季度我们专注于稳定性，而不是新功能。

name: UAT
example: The client will run UAT for one week before go-live.
exampleTrans: 客户会在正式上线前进行一周的用户验收测试。

name: go-live
example: The go-live date for the bank client is June first.
exampleTrans: 银行客户的正式上线日期是六月一日。

name: copy
example: Marketing will review the copy on the upgrade screen.
exampleTrans: 市场部会审阅升级页面上的文案。

name: error state
example: Please design an error state for failed file uploads.
exampleTrans: 请为文件上传失败设计一个错误状态。

name: touchpoint
example: Email is still the most important touchpoint for renewals.
exampleTrans: 邮件仍然是续费最重要的接触点。

name: personalization
example: Personalization of the home feed increased time spent.
exampleTrans: 首页信息流的个性化增加了用户使用时长。

name: retention curve
example: The retention curve flattens after week four, which is a good sign.
exampleTrans: 留存曲线在第四周后趋于平稳，这是个好迹象。

name: viral
example: The referral program made the app spread in a viral way.
exampleTrans: 推荐计划让应用以病毒式方式传播开来。

name: referral
example: Referrals now bring in a third of our new users.
exampleTrans: 推荐现在带来了三分之一的新用户。

name: channel
example: Search ads remain our most efficient acquisition channel.
exampleTrans: 搜索广告仍是我们效率最高的获客渠道。

name: messaging
example: Sales and marketing need consistent messaging about the new tier.
exampleTrans: 销售和市场需要就新档位保持一致的话术。

name: enablement
example: Sales enablement materials will be ready a week before launch.
exampleTrans: 销售赋能材料会在上线前一周准备好。

name: buy-in
example: We need buy-in from the sales team before changing pricing.
exampleTrans: 调整定价前我们需要获得销售团队的支持。

name: consensus
example: We reached consensus on cutting the reports feature.
exampleTrans: 我们就砍掉报表功能达成了共识。

name: push back
example: Engineering pushed back on the deadline as unrealistic.
exampleTrans: 研发对截止日期提出异议，认为不现实。

name: negotiate
example: I negotiated a smaller scope so we could keep the date.
exampleTrans: 我协商缩小了范围，以便保住日期。

name: executive
example: The executive team wants a demo before the board meeting.
exampleTrans: 高管团队希望在董事会前看到演示。

name: leadership
example: Leadership approved extra headcount for the platform team.
exampleTrans: 领导层批准了平台团队增加编制。

name: headcount
example: Without more headcount we have to cut a roadmap item.
exampleTrans: 没有更多编制，我们只能砍掉一个路线图事项。

name: vendor
example: We are evaluating two vendors for the payment gateway.
exampleTrans: 我们正在评估两家支付网关供应商。

name: renewal
example: Three enterprise renewals depend on shipping audit logs.
exampleTrans: 三家企业客户的续约取决于审计日志功能的上线。

name: deal breaker
example: Missing single sign-on is a deal breaker for large companies.
exampleTrans: 缺少单点登录对大公司来说是硬伤。

name: customer success
example: Customer success flagged that admins struggle with permissions.
exampleTrans: 客户成功团队反馈管理员在权限设置上很吃力。

name: feature request
example: We tag every feature request with the customer's plan.
exampleTrans: 我们给每个功能请求标注客户所用的套餐。

name: walkthrough
example: Let's do a walkthrough of the spec with the whole team.
exampleTrans: 我们和全队一起过一遍需求说明。

name: deep dive
example: Next week we'll do a deep dive into the churn data.
exampleTrans: 下周我们会深入分析流失数据。

name: unblock
example: Can someone from security unblock the data access request?
exampleTrans: 安全团队能有人帮忙解除这个数据访问请求的阻塞吗？

name: de-risk
example: A small pilot will de-risk the full rollout.
exampleTrans: 小规模试点会降低全面推广的风险。

name: product discovery
example: Product discovery showed that teams needed approvals more than templates.
exampleTrans: 产品发现表明，团队更需要审批功能而不是模板。

name: continuous discovery
example: Continuous discovery keeps our roadmap connected to current customer problems.
exampleTrans: 持续发现让路线图始终联系当前的客户问题。

name: problem space
example: We must understand the problem space before discussing features.
exampleTrans: 讨论功能之前，我们必须理解问题空间。

name: solution space
example: The workshop explored the solution space without committing to one design.
exampleTrans: 研讨会探索了方案空间，但没有确定单一设计。

name: product brief
example: The product brief clarifies the audience, problem, and desired outcome.
exampleTrans: 产品简报明确了目标用户、问题和期望结果。

name: product requirement
example: Each product requirement should connect to a measurable customer outcome.
exampleTrans: 每项产品需求都应关联可衡量的客户结果。

name: functional requirement
example: This functional requirement defines how users export monthly reports.
exampleTrans: 这项功能需求定义了用户如何导出月度报告。

name: business requirement
example: The business requirement is reducing support costs this quarter.
exampleTrans: 这项业务需求是降低本季度的支持成本。

name: product principle
example: Our product principle favors user control over automatic decisions.
exampleTrans: 我们的产品原则倾向于让用户控制，而非自动决策。

name: decision log
example: Update the decision log after stakeholders approve the revised scope.
exampleTrans: 干系人批准调整后的范围后，请更新决策记录。

name: release plan
example: The release plan sequences migration before the public launch.
exampleTrans: 发布计划把迁移安排在公开上线之前。

name: launch plan
example: The launch plan assigns owners for training and customer communication.
exampleTrans: 上线计划为培训和客户沟通指定了负责人。

name: release train
example: This feature missed the release train because compliance review slipped.
exampleTrans: 由于合规审查延期，这项功能错过了发布列车。

name: product operations
example: Product operations standardized how teams collect and share customer feedback.
exampleTrans: 产品运营体系规范了团队收集和共享客户反馈的方式。

name: intake process
example: The intake process routes urgent requests to the right product owner.
exampleTrans: 需求受理流程会把紧急请求分派给合适的产品负责人。

name: feature parity
example: Feature parity is required before customers migrate from the legacy app.
exampleTrans: 客户从旧应用迁移前，需要实现功能对等。

name: product adoption
example: Product adoption improved after we simplified the initial setup.
exampleTrans: 我们简化初始设置后，产品采用率提高了。

name: activation rate
example: The activation rate rose when onboarding highlighted the first key action.
exampleTrans: 新手引导突出第一个关键操作后，激活率上升了。

name: retention rate
example: The retention rate declined among customers without team invitations.
exampleTrans: 未邀请团队成员的客户留存率下降了。

name: feature usage
example: Feature usage indicates that few admins review the audit log.
exampleTrans: 功能使用情况表明，很少有管理员查看审计日志。

name: monthly recurring revenue
example: Monthly recurring revenue grew despite lower new customer acquisition.
exampleTrans: 尽管新客获取减少，月度经常性收入仍然增长。

name: annual recurring revenue
example: Annual recurring revenue helps us compare subscription growth year over year.
exampleTrans: 年度经常性收入帮助我们逐年比较订阅增长。

name: customer lifetime value
example: Customer lifetime value supports increased investment in onboarding.
exampleTrans: 客户终身价值支持我们增加对新手引导的投入。

name: customer acquisition cost
example: Customer acquisition cost exceeded our target after advertising prices increased.
exampleTrans: 广告价格上涨后，客户获取成本超过了目标。

name: average order value
example: Average order value increased after we introduced annual bundles.
exampleTrans: 推出年度套餐后，平均订单金额提高了。

name: conversion funnel
example: The conversion funnel reveals a sharp drop before payment confirmation.
exampleTrans: 转化漏斗显示付款确认前出现明显流失。

name: funnel stage
example: We assigned one success metric to each funnel stage.
exampleTrans: 我们为每个漏斗阶段指定了一项成功指标。

name: event tracking
example: Event tracking must distinguish invited users from organic signups.
exampleTrans: 事件追踪必须区分受邀用户和自然注册用户。

name: tracking plan
example: The tracking plan defines every event, property, and responsible owner.
exampleTrans: 埋点方案定义了每个事件、属性和负责人。

name: metric tree
example: The metric tree connects checkout speed to completed purchases.
exampleTrans: 指标树把结账速度与完成购买关联起来。

name: counter metric
example: Support volume is a counter metric for the faster signup experiment.
exampleTrans: 支持请求量是快速注册实验的一项反向指标。

name: product analytics
example: Product analytics showed which workflow retained new teams.
exampleTrans: 产品分析显示了哪种工作流能留住新团队。

name: behavioral cohort
example: A behavioral cohort revealed stronger retention among template creators.
exampleTrans: 行为群组分析显示模板创建者的留存更强。

name: minimum detectable effect
example: Minimum detectable effect determines how long our experiment must run.
exampleTrans: 最小可检测效应决定了实验需要运行多久。

name: confidence interval
example: The confidence interval remains too wide for a launch decision.
exampleTrans: 置信区间仍然太宽，无法支持上线决策。

name: statistical power
example: Statistical power is low because the eligible audience is small.
exampleTrans: 由于符合条件的受众较少，统计功效偏低。

name: roadmap theme
example: Each roadmap theme describes an outcome rather than a feature list.
exampleTrans: 每个路线图主题描述的是结果，而不是功能清单。

name: now next later
trans: n. 近期中期远期路线图
example: Now next later communicates direction without promising exact delivery dates.
exampleTrans: 近期中期远期路线图传达方向，而不承诺准确交付日期。

name: product council
example: The product council resolved the conflict between regional priorities.
exampleTrans: 产品决策委员会解决了区域优先级之间的冲突。

name: executive sponsor
example: Our executive sponsor secured funding for the platform migration.
exampleTrans: 我们的高管发起人为平台迁移争取到了资金。
